hardware_command_buffer.memory_type: Unified System RAM (CPU write-combined, GPU cacheable)

flags.desc: Execution flags: Coherent, Sync, Profiling, Secure

field_layout_64_bytes.description: 64-bit unique telemetry and profiling trace identifier
64-bit GPU virtual address pointing to contiguous token payload buffer

allocated_bytes.desc: Total allocated buffer capacity (16 KB page multiple)

field_layout_64_bytes.description: 64-bit pointer / token for IOGPUIOFenceListHead and AGXBlockFence synchronizations
GPU virtual address of Parameter Scene Allocation (MList / MTileArray / VHeap)
64-bit Metal shared event completion descriptor and signaling mask

0x01.name: CMD_3D_RENDER_PASS
0x01.description: Submits full 3D TBDR render pass (Vertex/Tiling phase followed by Fragment phase)

0x02.name: CMD_COMPUTE_DISPATCH
0x02.description: Launches general-purpose compute kernel threadgroups into USC clusters

0x03.name: CMD_RAY_TRACING_BVH_BUILD
0x03.description: Constructs or refits acceleration structures (BVH2 / BVH4) using hardware traversal accelerators

0x04.name: CMD_RAY_TRACING_DISPATCH
0x04.description: Executes ray-generation, intersection, and closest-hit shaders with hardware RIA stack

0x05.name: CMD_TILE_LOAD_STORE
0x05.description: Explicit on-chip tile memory load/store operations to/from DRAM

0x06.name: CMD_BLIT_COPY
0x06.description: Hardware 2D memory copy, buffer clear, and texture sub-resource remapping

0x07.name: CMD_BARRIER_FENCE
0x07.description: Inserts pipeline execution barrier and flushes USC L1 instruction/data caches

0x08.name: CMD_SHARED_EVENT_SIGNAL
0x08.description: Signals a Metal SharedEvent object upon hardware completion of preceding commands

0x09.name: CMD_SHARED_EVENT_WAIT
0x09.description: Suspends pipeline execution until specified SharedEvent reaches threshold value

0x0F.name: CMD_NOP
0x0F.description: No-operation descriptor used for ring alignment, latency pads, and heartbeat keepalive
